informal_statement: If a model satisfies a larger theory, it necessarily satisfies all subtheories of that theory. In other words, any model of a larger set of axioms automatically models any smaller set of axioms contained within it.
informal_proof: Assume we have a model M that satisfies a larger theory T. The subtheory U consists of a subset of the axioms in T. Since all axioms in U are also in T, and M satisfies T, it follows that M must satisfy every axiom in U. Therefore, M is a model of U as well.

  | @axL _ _ Δ _ r v => by
    by_cases h : s.rel r (Semiterm.valm M ![] ε ∘ v)
    · exact ⟨rel r v, by simp, h⟩
    · exact ⟨nrel r v, by simp, h⟩
  | verum Δ => ⟨⊤, by simp⟩
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d => by
    have : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ Evalfm M ε ψ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε d
    rcases this with (hp | hq | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
    · exact ⟨φ ⋎ ψ, by simp, by simp [hp]⟩
    · exact ⟨φ ⋎ ψ, by simp, by simp [hq]⟩
    · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq => by
    have : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ r ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε r := by simpa using sound M ε dp
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
    · have : Evalfm M ε ψ ∨ ∃ r ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε r := by simpa using sound M ε dq
      rcases this with (hq | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
      · exact ⟨φ ⋏ ψ, by simp, by simp [hp, hq]⟩
      · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
    · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d => by
    have : (∀ a : M, Evalm M ![a] ε φ) ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by
      simpa [Rewriting.shifts, Matrix.vecConsLast_vecEmpty, forall_or_right]
        using fun a : M => sound M (a :>ₙ ε) d
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨ψ, hq, hhq⟩)
    · exact ⟨∀' φ, by simp, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hq], hhq⟩
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d => by
    have : Evalm M ![t.valm M ![] ε] ε φ ∨ ∃ φ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε φ := by
      simpa[eval_substs, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using sound M ε d
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨ψ, hq, hhq⟩)
    · exact ⟨∃' φ, by simp, t.valm M ![] ε, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hq], hhq⟩

    rcases this with ⟨φ, hp, h⟩

    have hn : ¬Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε dn
    rcases h with (h | ⟨ψ, h, hq⟩)
    · rcases hn with (hn | ⟨ψ, hn, hq⟩)
      · contradiction
      · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hn], hq⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [h], hq⟩
  | root (φ := φ) h => ⟨φ, by simp, Theory.models M T h ε⟩

end Derivation

informal_statement: If a logical system is sound, then it is consistent. This means that within the system, every theorem derived is always true, and there exists no statement for which both it and its negation can be derived as theorems.
informal_proof:
Assume that a logical system \( T \) is sound. By definition of soundness, every theorem \( \phi \) in \( T \) is a tautology, meaning \( T \vdash! \phi \) if and only if \( T \vDash \phi \).

Now, suppose for contradiction that \( T \) is inconsistent. By definition of inconsistency, there exists some statement \( \phi \) such that both \( \phi \) and \( \neg \phi \) are theorems of \( T \), i.e., \( T \vdash! \phi \) and \( T \vdash! \neg \phi \).

However, since \( T \) is sound, both \( \phi \) and \( \neg \phi \) must be tautologies. But a statement and its negation cannot both be tautologies because a tautology is always true, and its negation is always false. informal_statement: If there is a derivation of a formula \( \phi \) within a theory \( T \), then \( \phi \) must be true in every model of \( T \). In other words, \( T \) logically implies \( \phi \) in all possible structures.
informal_proof:
1. **Assumption:** Let \( T \) be a theory and \( \phi \) a formula that is derivable from \( T \), denoted \( T \vdash \phi \).
2. **Definition of Soundness:** Soundness in logical systems ensures that every theorem derivable from a theory is universally true in all models of that theory.
3. **Application to the Derivation:** Given \( T \vdash \phi \), and assuming \( T \) is sound, it follows by the definition of soundness that \( \phi \) is true in every model (structure) that satisfies \( T \).
4. **Formal Expression:** This relationship is formally expressed as \( T \vDash_{\mathcal{S}} \phi \), meaning \( \phi \) is true in the class \( \mathcal{S} \) of structures \( [Struc.\{v, u\} L] \) that satisfy \( T \).
5. **Conclusion:** Therefore, the existence of a derivation from \( T \) to \( \phi \) ensures \( \phi \)'s universal truth across all models of \( T \), confirming the soundness of the theory with respect to its derivable formula \( \phi \).

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.

lemma sound (M : Type*) [s : Structure L M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊧ₘ* T] (ε : ℕ → M) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → ∃ φ ∈ Γ, Evalfm M ε φ
  | @axL _ _ Δ _ r v => by
    by_cases h : s.rel r (Semiterm.valm M ![] ε ∘ v)
    · exact ⟨rel r v, by simp, h⟩
    · exact ⟨nrel r v, by simp, h⟩
  | verum Δ => ⟨⊤, by simp⟩
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d => by
    have : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ Evalfm M ε ψ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε d
    rcases this with (hp | hq | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
    · exact ⟨φ ⋎ ψ, by simp, by simp [hp]⟩
    · exact ⟨φ ⋎ ψ, by simp, by simp [hq]⟩
    · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq => by
    have : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ r ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε r := by simpa using sound M ε dp
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
    · have : Evalfm M ε ψ ∨ ∃ r ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε r := by simpa using sound M ε dq
      rcases this with (hq | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
      · exact ⟨φ ⋏ ψ, by simp, by simp [hp, hq]⟩
      · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
    · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d => by
    have : (∀ a : M, Evalm M ![a] ε φ) ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by
      simpa [Rewriting.shifts, Matrix.vecConsLast_vecEmpty, forall_or_right]
        using fun a : M => sound M (a :>ₙ ε) d
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨ψ, hq, hhq⟩)
    · exact ⟨∀' φ, by simp, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hq], hhq⟩
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d => by
    have : Evalm M ![t.valm M ![] ε] ε φ ∨ ∃ φ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε φ := by
      simpa[eval_substs, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using sound M ε d
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨ψ, hq, hhq⟩)
    · exact ⟨∃' φ, by simp, t.valm M ![] ε, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hq], hhq⟩
  | @wk _ _ Γ Δ d ss => by
    have : ∃ φ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε φ := sound M ε d
    rcases this with ⟨φ, hp, h⟩
    exact ⟨φ, ss hp, h⟩
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn => by
    have h : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε d
    have hn : ¬Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε dn
    rcases h with (h | ⟨ψ, h, hq⟩)
    · rcases hn with (hn | ⟨ψ, hn, hq⟩)
      · contradiction
      · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hn], hq⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [h], hq⟩
  | root (φ := φ) h => ⟨φ, by simp, Theory.models M T h ε⟩

  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++

  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

def rewrite {Δ} : T ⟹ Δ → ∀ (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L), T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
  | axL Δ r v,            f =>
    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @wk _ _ Δ Γ d ss,     f => (rewrite d f).wk (List.map_subset _ ss)
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn,    f =>
    have dΔ : T ⟹ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp)
    have dΓ : T ⟹ ∼(Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite dn f) (by simp)
    Derivation.cast (cut dΔ dΓ) (by simp)
  | root h,               f => rewrite₁ (root h) f

@[elab_as_elim]
def formulaRec {C : SyntacticFormula L → Sort _}
  (verum  : C ⊤)
  (falsum : C ⊥)
  (rel    : ∀ {l : ℕ} (r : L.Rel l) (v : Fin l → SyntacticTerm L), C (rel r v))
  (nrel   : ∀ {l : ℕ} (r : L.Rel l) (v : Fin l → SyntacticTerm L), C (nrel r v))
  (and    : ∀ (φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (or     : ∀ (φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (all    : ∀ (φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1), C (Rewriting.free φ) → C (∀' φ))
  (ex     : ∀ (φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1), C (Rewriting.free φ) → C (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ (φ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ
  | ⊤         => verum
  | ⊥         => falsum
  | .rel r v  => rel r v
  | .nrel r v => nrel r v
  | φ ⋏ ψ     => and φ ψ (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex φ) (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ     => or φ ψ  (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex φ) (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex ψ)
  | ∀' φ      => all φ   (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex (Rewriting.free φ))
  | ∃' φ      => ex φ    (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex (Rewriting.free φ))
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

lemma eval_ofEquiv_iff : ∀ {n} {e : Fin n → N} {ε : ξ → N} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n},
    Eval (ofEquiv Θ) e ε φ ↔ Eval s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε) φ
  | _, e, ε, ⊤         => by simp
  | _, e, ε, ⊥         => by simp
  | _, e, ε, .rel r v  => by simp [Function.comp_def, eval_rel, ofEquiv_rel Θ, Structure.ofEquiv_val Θ]
  | _, e, ε, .nrel r v => by simp [Function.comp_def, eval_nrel, ofEquiv_rel Θ, Structure.ofEquiv_val Θ]
  | _, e, ε, φ ⋏ ψ     => by simp [eval_ofEquiv_iff (φ := φ), eval_ofEquiv_iff (φ := ψ)]
  | _, e, ε, φ ⋎ ψ     => by simp [eval_ofEquiv_iff (φ := φ), eval_ofEquiv_iff (φ := ψ)]
  | _, e, ε, ∀' φ      => by
    simp; exact
    ⟨fun h x => by simpa[Matrix.comp_vecCons''] using eval_ofEquiv_iff.mp (h (Θ x)),
     fun h x => eval_ofEquiv_iff.mpr (by simpa[Matrix.comp_vecCons''] using h (Θ.symm x))⟩
  | _, e, ε, ∃' φ      => by
    simp; exact
    ⟨by rintro ⟨x, h⟩; exists Θ.symm x; simpa[Matrix.comp_vecCons''] using eval_ofEquiv_iff.mp h,
     by rintro ⟨x, h⟩; exists Θ x; apply eval_ofEquiv_iff.mpr; simpa[Matrix.comp_vecCons''] using h⟩

lemma eval_iff_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn φ.FVar? ε ε') :
    Eval s e ε φ ↔ Eval s e ε' φ := by
  induction φ using Semiformula.rec'
  case hverum => simp
  case hfalsum => simp
  case hrel k r v =>
    simp [eval_rel]; apply iff_of_eq; congr
    funext i
    exact Semiterm.val_eq_of_funEqOn (v i) (fun x hx ↦ h x (fvar?_rel.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩))
  case hnrel k r v =>
    simp [eval_nrel]; apply iff_of_eq; congr
    funext i
    exact Semiterm.val_eq_of_funEqOn (v i) (fun x hx ↦ h x (fvar?_nrel.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩))
  case hand φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    simp; apply and_congr
    · exact ihp fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
    · exact ihq fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
  case hor φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    simp; apply or_congr
    · exact ihp fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
    · exact ihq fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
  case hall φ ih =>
    simp; apply forall_congr'; intro x
    exact ih (fun x hx ↦ h _ $ by simp [FVar?]; exact hx)
  case hex φ ih =>
    simp; apply exists_congr; intro x
    exact ih (fun x hx ↦ h _ $ by simp [FVar?]; exact hx)

informal_proof:
To establish the soundness of the logical system, we proceed by examining each logical construct and structural rule in the lemma's proof. 

1. **Axiomatic Cases**: 
   - For axioms, the system ensures that each axiom \( \varphi \) evaluates to true under any interpretation \( \varepsilon \). This is verified by direct evaluation, as the axioms are fundamental building blocks of the system.
   - For the `verum` case, representing the logical constant `true`, the evaluation under any interpretation \( \varepsilon \) confirms its validity.
   
2. **Logical Connectives**:
   - **Disjunction (`@or`)**: If either \( \varphi \) or \( \psi \) is true under \( \varepsilon \), then \( \varphi \lor \psi \) is also true. This is proven by examining each case where \( \varphi \) or \( \psi \) holds and confirming the disjunction's truth.
   - **Conjunction (`@and`)**: The system ensures that if both \( \varphi \) and \( \psi \) are true under \( \varepsilon \), then \( \varphi \land \psi \) holds true. This involves checking that all conjuncts evaluate correctly under the given interpretation.
   - **Universal Quantification (`@all`)**: The soundness of universal statements is maintained by ensuring that for every element in the domain, the property holds. This is verified by applying the interpretation \( \varepsilon \) to all elements and checking the truth of the quantified statement.
   - **Existential Quantification (`@ex`)**: The system confirms that if there exists an element satisfying \( \varphi \), then \( \exists x.\varphi \) is true under \( \varepsilon \). This involves identifying at least one such element and verifying its satisfaction under \( \varepsilon \).

3. **Structural Rules**:
   - **Weakening (`@wk`)**: This rule allows the addition of formulas that are trivially true, without affecting the soundness since the original formulas remain valid.
   - **Cut Rule (`@cut`)**: The system ensures that intermediate conclusions are valid by eliminating unnecessary logical steps, maintaining the soundness of the overall proof structure.

By methodically addressing each case and ensuring that all logical constructs and structural rules adhere to the system's axioms and evaluation conditions, the lemma demonstrates the fundamental property of soundness—that everything provable is indeed true under every interpretation. lemma sound (M : Type*) [s : Structure L M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊧ₘ* T] (ε : ℕ → M) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → ∃ φ ∈ Γ, Evalfm M ε φ
  | @axL _ _ Δ _ r v => by
    by_cases h : s.rel r (Semiterm.valm M ![] ε ∘ v)
    · exact ⟨rel r v, by simp, h⟩
    · exact ⟨nrel r v, by simp, h⟩
  | verum Δ => ⟨⊤, by simp⟩
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d => by
    have : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ Evalfm M ε ψ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε d
    rcases this with (hp | hq | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
    · exact ⟨φ ⋎ ψ, by simp, by simp [hp]⟩
    · exact ⟨φ ⋎ ψ, by simp, by simp [hq]⟩
    · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq => by
    have : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ r ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε r := by simpa using sound M ε dp
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
    · have : Evalfm M ε ψ ∨ ∃ r ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε r := by simpa using sound M ε dq
      rcases this with (hq | ⟨r, hr, hhr⟩)
      · exact ⟨φ ⋏ ψ, by simp, by simp [hp, hq]⟩
      · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
    · exact ⟨r, by simp [hr], hhr⟩
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d => by
    have : (∀ a : M, Evalm M ![a] ε φ) ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by
      simpa [Rewriting.shifts, Matrix.vecConsLast_vecEmpty, forall_or_right]
        using fun a : M => sound M (a :>ₙ ε) d
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨ψ, hq, hhq⟩)
    · exact ⟨∀' φ, by simp, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hq], hhq⟩
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d => by
    have : Evalm M ![t.valm M ![] ε] ε φ ∨ ∃ φ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε φ := by
      simpa[eval_substs, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using sound M ε d
    rcases this with (hp | ⟨ψ, hq, hhq⟩)
    · exact ⟨∃' φ, by simp, t.valm M ![] ε, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hq], hhq⟩
  | @wk _ _ Γ Δ d ss => by
    have : ∃ φ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε φ := sound M ε d
    rcases this with ⟨φ, hp, h⟩
    exact ⟨φ, ss hp, h⟩
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn => by
    have h : Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε d
    have hn : ¬Evalfm M ε φ ∨ ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, Evalfm M ε ψ := by simpa using sound M ε dn
    rcases h with (h | ⟨ψ, h, hq⟩)
    · rcases hn with (hn | ⟨ψ, hn, hq⟩)
      · contradiction
      · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [hn], hq⟩
    · exact ⟨ψ, by simp [h], hq⟩
  | root (φ := φ) h => ⟨φ, by simp, Theory.models M T h ε⟩

    have := i.isLt; contradiction )
